claims: Artemis II is the first crewed mission to leave Earth’s orbit and journey to the vicinity of the Moon since 1972.
Artemis II launches in April 2026.
Artemis II is a 10-day test mission.
Artemis II will take four astronauts farther into space than any humans in history.
Artemis II is the first crewed deep space flight in 50+ years.
Artemis II breaks the half-century gap since the final Apollo mission.
Artemis II crew will travel roughly 4,700 miles beyond the far side of the Moon.
Artemis II is the most distant human journey ever attempted.
Artemis II beats Apollo 13's record.
Artemis II features Christina Koch as the first woman to travel beyond low Earth orbit.
Artemis II features Victor Glover as the first person of color to travel beyond low Earth orbit.
Artemis II features Jeremy Hansen as the first Canadian to travel beyond low Earth orbit.
Artemis II is a test of the Orion spacecraft with a crew.
Artemis II is a test of the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket with a crew.
Artemis II is a precursor to the Artemis III mission.
Artemis III will land astronauts at the lunar South Pole.
Artemis II crew will test systems for future Mars missions.
Artemis II crew will conduct deep-space radiation experiments.
Artemis II crew will validate life support systems needed for long-term human presence in space.
Artemis II takes off from Kennedy Space Center
